declaration_source: Project owner reply during reclaimed-install audit
question: Did you create all the imported models, textures, animations, and sound recordings, or are any from other creators or asset packs?
scope: Original Plastic Platoon models, textures, animations, maps, and sound recordings
Original editable model, map, texture and audio source inputs
Original generated bootstrap and support assets

generated_assets.prompt: Create the full-bleed widescreen static main-menu background art for an original PC and handheld video game, Plastic Platoon, about green molded plastic toy soldiers in oversized everyday spaces. Landscape 16:9 composition. Show an outdoor backyard at toy-eye level: coarse grains of sand, towering blades of grass, a weathered wooden sandbox lip and soft late-afternoon light. Put the main visual beat around 70% across the frame, a small squad of unmistakably toy-green plastic soldiers peeking over the sandbox lip, one clearly readable helmet silhouette and shoulders in the foreground, two smaller figures farther back. They should look like classic solid-green miniature figurines with mold seams, lightly scuffed satin surfaces and simplified features. Behind them, hazy garden foliage and a tipped terracotta pot establish huge scale. Original stylized 3D game key art with tactile diorama materials, earthy olives and warm amber, dark muted shadows, an adventurous toy-scale mood. Keep the left half and the central-left area visually quiet and dark with softly out-of-focus soil and wood so existing centrally placed controls stay readable, with the strongest detail near the right. Keep the lead soldier fully within the central 70% of the frame so a square crop will retain the helmet silhouette. No typography, UI, logos, real people, blood, muzzle flashes or framing borders.
generated_assets.notes: One generated image with no external image inputs, packaged as a widescreen rendition and a square handheld crop.
